limitations: The 15th Amendment includes only Annex II changed pages. Maturity Date, Section 7.12, Section 8.04 and the revolving commitments are not restated; operative terms are taken from the credit agreement as conformed in the 14th Amendment and cannot be shown to be unchanged from any 15th page beyond Section 1(b) listing only Annex II as the amendment.

The 13th Amendment recital gives $175,000,000 of incremental revolving commitments while its Schedule A totals $277,500,000 incremental and $372,500,000 refinancing; both total $650,000,000. The split is recorded as conflicting.
The agreement states the springing test as Revolving Loans exceeding 30% of commitments; the 10-Q describes it as 30.00% or more. The agreement text is used.
The 14th and 15th Amendments are dated and effective on their dates; the 15th is dated the cutoff date, 2025-08-18, and is treated as in scope.
The 10-K (filed 2025-02-27) is the only corpus source for the 6.000% notes call terms and the ownership percentages (as of 2024-12-31); the 10-Q after that date does not update them.
The 2024-06-30 10-Q is in the corpus folder but not in the manifest and was not used.

Scale: the checker allows millions, units, thousands or null. Values printed in USD thousands (10-Q tables) use scale "thousands"; amounts printed as $X million use millions; credit agreement dollar amounts use units; percents and ratios use null.

Redline reading: the 13th, 14th and 15th Amendment annexes are redlines, and visible text carries struck and inserted figures together with no separator (for example "6.504.75" is 6.50 struck and 4.75 inserted). Quotes keep that concatenated text because the checker reads visible text only. Struck versus inserted was read from the line-through and underline styles in the HTML. Every fact whose field is not a "before", "removed" or "struck" value holds the post-amendment (inserted) figure; "before" and "struck" facts hold the struck figure.

Codex financial_gold marks LTH:FY2025Q2:principal as missing; this golden holds 1,534,149 (thousands) from the 10-Q maturity table "Total future maturities of long-term debt $ 1,534,149", equal to the component sum. Scoring must not treat that difference as a conflict.

CP-0 identity facts are from the 2025-06-30 10-Q cover (and the 10-K cover for the fiscal year end); the filings print no sector label, so context.json identity.sector uses the 10-Q's own wording "premium health, fitness and wellness experiences".
